name: zclass_cls_di_probe_hit_batches_for_segments
description: zClass_cls_di::BuildProbeHitBatchesForSegments prepares segment-pair probe batches, computes per-segment bounds and active masks, initializes DI globals, dispatches the grid-window and top-level segment walkers, and clears the stop-after-first global.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass DI segment-batch source-cluster pass. The world Z overlap test preserves the Binary Ninja-observed asymmetric original coordinate convention used before grid-window dispatch.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x445d40 validates the ECX world, EDX segment endpoint array, stack endpoint-count and hit-batch arguments, cap at 24 input points, type-list flush, segmentCount = endpointCount / 2, output candidate-count clearing, per-segment active mask initialization, endpoint-pair min/max bounds writes to g_DiSegmentBounds, world overlap rejection when clampQueriesToBounds is zero, matrix stack identity scope, g_DiPickCandidateBuffer/g_DiPickPointArray/g_DiPickPointCount setup, BuildPickCandidatesForSegmentsInGridWindow call, top-level world child dispatch through enabled/raycastable/variant gates, break-on-first check against the first candidate bucket, matrix pop, and final g_cls_di_StopAfterFirstHit reset.
